song.title: I Heard It Through The Grapevine

guitar.evidence: Marvin Gaye was primarily a vocalist (and drummer/keyboardist); Motown session guitarists (e.g. the Funk Brothers) played on his records without a documented personal-to-Marvin Gaye signature guitar.
guitar.notes: Correctly unknown — vocalist, not a guitarist-led act.
